position: CoAP message header Code field (byte after version/type/token length in UDP; first byte after length field in TCP/WebSockets)
explanation: Used to distinguish the type of CoAP request operation: standard REST methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and extended methods (FETCH, PATCH, iPATCH) as well as signaling messages (Ping, Pong). The Code field is an 8-bit unsigned integer split into a 3-bit class and 5-bit detail; for requests, class 0 indicates a method code, while class 7 indicates a signaling code.
